en.headline: Lee pledges building maintenance reforms and bid-rigging study after Tai Po fire
en.dek: The chief executive said a legal study on criminalising bid-rigging in major works would go to LegCo this year, alongside pre-qualified contractor lists and stronger oversight.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Wednesday that the government would overhaul Hong Kong’s building maintenance regime and improve emergency response in the wake of last year’s fatal fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po.

In his Policy Address, Lee said officials would conduct a legal study on criminalising bid-rigging in major building maintenance works and submit a proposal to the Legislative Council this year. The government would also introduce pre-qualified lists of consultants and contractors that have passed background checks by law-enforcement agencies to help owners select professionals for renovation projects.

Lee added that tender invitation and evaluation services would be launched for the first time to assist property owners, and that amendments to the Buildings Ordinance and Building Management Ordinance were expected to reach LegCo this year to strengthen controls, raise penalties and reform voting thresholds for large-scale maintenance works.

The measures come after the November 2025 blaze at the Tai Po estate, which killed 168 people and prompted hundreds of charges against firms and individuals linked to the renovation project under way at the time.

zh.headline: 李家超承諾改革樓宇維修制度 研圍標刑事化
zh.dek: 行政長官在施政報告中表示，會就大維修圍標行為進行法律研究，今年內向立法會提交建議，並推出預審顧問承建商名單及招標評標服務。
body: 行政長官李家超周三表示，政府會因應去年大埔宏福苑致命火災，全面改革本港樓宇維修制度及完善緊急應變。
李家超在《施政報告》中指，當局會就大維修工程圍標行為進行法律研究，並於今年內向立法會提交建議。政府亦會首次推出經執法機關背景審查的顧問及承建商預審名單，協助業主選擇專業人士，以及推出招標及評標服務。
他續指，《建築物條例》及《建築物管理條例》的修訂預期今年提交立法會，以加強對維修工程的規管、加重罰則，以及提高大型維修工程表決門檻。
有關措施是在2025年11月宏福苑大火後提出，該場火災造成168人死亡，當局其後對相關顧問公司、承建商及個人提出數百項控罪。
